text:
auditor-bot: Auditor here — SOC2 fieldwork request: deliver KMS rotation proof, RBAC promotion/rollback logs (last 120d), CloudTrail raw events around rotations, vuln triage for CVE-2025-9999 (linked IR-2026-042), Opsgenie alert history, and a signed delivery manifest (SHA256 per file + HMAC using auditor-provided nonce). Delivery requested by 2026-04-28 EOD. Confirm owners?

rachel: i'll coordinate packaging and the custody manifest. @omar take CloudTrail + RBAC CSVs, @mei take KMS/HSM artifacts, @sam will assemble vuln triage. legal — can you prep custody stmt template referencing HMAC key id? 

omar: confirmed. i'll produce a CSV timeline (human-readable) AND raw CloudTrail JSONs. Splunk snippet i'll use for RBAC timeline:
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=CreateRole OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventName=DetachRolePolicy
| table _time,userIdentity.arn,eventName,requestParameters,eventID
| where _time >= relative_time(now(), "-120d@d")
```
I'll stage to s3://redwood-evidence/audit/rbac/ and s3://redwood-evidence/audit/raw/. Tag objects with checksum-sha256 and manifest-id when uploading.

mei: KMS notes — CMKs in scope: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/aa11 and /bb22. Rotations: 2026-03-30 and 2025-11-03. I'll include: key policy revision diffs, GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext/Encrypt/Decrypt CloudTrail events, CloudHSM import logs, and vendor attestation PDF. Staging path: s3://redwood-evidence/kms/fieldwork-20260428/

sam: vuln triage bundle (CVE-2025-9999) will include timeline, root cause hypothesis, PRs and SHAs, mitigations, regression test IDs, and monitoring snapshots. I'll attach a one-page executive summary for auditors.

rachel: legal — custody statement should say HMAC key id and that the auditor nonce will be used. We need an HSM-protected mapping for any redacted principals.

legal: draft custody text: "Redwood Inference attests custody of the listed artifacts from collection through delivery. Manifest is HMAC-SHA256 signed using internal key id=hk-2024-03 and includes the auditor-supplied nonce. Contact legal@redwood for verification." OK?

rachel: yes. engsec-bot — can we include a small verify script for the auditor that recomputes SHA256 and HMAC? 

engsec-bot: yes — we'll include verify_manifest.sh and instructions: `verify_manifest.sh manifest.json <hmac> <auditor-nonce>`. Steps: download objects, compute sha256sum, compare to manifest, compute HMAC-SHA256(manifest_json, nonce) and compare.

ops-bot: reminder: presigned URL TTL = 7 days. Use `s3-presign --expires 604800`. Add tags: checksum-sha256 and manifest-id. Mark email_redaction=true on affected objects.

omar: ETA: CSVs + raw bundles uploaded by 2026-04-25 EOD. I'll post presigned links in-thread. I will also include eventIDs in CSV for auditor correlation.

mei: ETA for KMS/HSM bundle: 2026-04-24 EOD. Note: one CMK uses vendor-wrapped key material; i'll include vendor thumbprint and import log. Redaction map will be HSM-protected and only provided under NDA.

sam: vuln bundle ETA: 2026-04-22 EOD. I'll include short regression run results and the incident IR-2026-042 Opsgenie references.

omar: also will export Opsgenie alert history for IR-2026-042 (alerts, responders, escalation timeline) and add to s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/IR-2026-042/alerts.json.

rachel: packaging checklist: - RBAC CSV + raw CloudTrail -> omar - KMS/HSM bundle -> mei - Vulnerability triage -> sam - Opsgenie alerts -> omar - Signed manifest + custody statement -> rachel/legal. Pre-review by eng-security on 2026-04-26 AM.

rachel: auditors will need to provide the nonce at delivery time so we can compute HMAC(manifest, nonce). Please escalate in #eng-security with :rotating_light: if anyone misses ETA.

auditor-bot: Acknowledged. Auditor will validate SHA256 checksums and HMAC upon receipt and may request a short verification call. Thank you!
